title: U.S. Weapons Crunch Raises Risks Beyond Iran
text:
The Pentagon presses defense companies to accelerate weapons production as the Iran war depletes key US stockpiles and raises questions about readiness in other regions. Brigadier General Mark Kimmitt (Ret) and Bloomberg Economics Defense Lead and adjunct senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security Becca Wasser are on Bloomberg This Weekend and say the US has used at least half of its Patriot stockpile in the Iran conflict, forcing tougher choices over supplies for allies including Ukraine.
Watch the full interview on Bloomberg.
